info.title: Optimize All API
info.description: Paid social sharing campaigns: participants, campaigns, submissions, review, ledger and payouts.

get.summary: Every active achievement with the caller's progress (current metric value) and award time.

put.summary: Updates an achievement. The key cannot change once the achievement has been awarded.

delete.summary: Deletes an achievement that was never awarded; awarded ones can only be deactivated (409 achievement.awarded).

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Action prefix, e.g. "admin." or "admin.user_suspended".

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Action prefix, e.g. "admin." or "admin.user_suspended".

delete.summary: Deletes an unused category; a category referenced by campaigns is deactivated instead.

post.summary: Creates a Draft with reward rules v1 (also requires rewards.edit).

Starts a time-boxed session as the user (requires `users.impersonate`, a reason and `"confirm": true`).
Returns the target's access token and sets the impersonation cookie; the caller's own refresh cookie is kept, so
`POST /api/v1/auth/impersonation/exit` returns to it. Admins, other impersonators, yourself and inactive
accounts are refused.
Runs a job now (requires settings.manage in addition to jobs.view).

get.summary: Built-in roles (read-only, with their permission sets) and custom roles.
Every permission grouped by area with labels and descriptions; `granted` = the caller may grant it.

delete.summary: Deletes an unassigned role; an assigned one needs `?confirm=true` (optionally `&reassignTo={roleId}`).

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Required when the role is still assigned: removes (or moves) every assignment.

parameters.name: ReassignTo
parameters.description: Optional: move the current holders to this custom role before deleting.

get.summary: A user's custom roles and effective permissions.

post.summary: Restores the built-in default value.

parameters.name: AssignedTo
parameters.description: A user id, "me" or "unassigned".

post.summary: Public reply (sets AwaitingParticipant and notifies the participant) or internal note.
Creates a verified test user with the given roles; the generated password is in this response only.

delete.summary: Deactivates a test account and signs it out everywhere. Real accounts answer 409.

parameters.name: Permission
parameters.description: Only users holding this permission through a built-in or custom role (e.g. support.manage for assignee pickers).

parameters.name: IsTestAccount
parameters.description: true: only test accounts; false: only real accounts; omitted: both.

parameters.name: Permission
parameters.description: Only users holding this permission through a built-in or custom role (e.g. support.manage for assignee pickers).

parameters.name: IsTestAccount
parameters.description: true: only test accounts; false: only real accounts; omitted: both.

post.summary: Creates a verified staff account and emails a set-password (reset) link.

delete.summary: Deletes an ad account registered by mistake (no campaigns, metrics or imports). Otherwise deactivate it.

post.summary: Runs the reporting sync now. Without credentials the result is NotConfigured and nothing is written.
Plans a campaign internally; the client's naming template is enforced.

delete.summary:
Deletes a planned campaign without reported metrics, with its ad groups and ads. Synced or imported campaigns (or any
with metrics) are history: set their status to Removed instead.

get.summary: Spend, ROAS and CPA across all clients (each in its own currency, plus agency totals in currency).
Ads KPIs of one client for reports (reports.manage or ads.manage); see docs/api/social-ads.md.
Pacing board: every budget of the month with actual vs expected-to-date and the month-end projection.

post.summary: Reopens an acknowledged or resolved alert (e.g. resolved by mistake).

delete.summary: Deletes a draft or archived plan. An approved plan is the agreed budget: archive it first.

get.summary: Actual vs plan: per line, actual spend of the platform's accounts during the flight (converted to the plan currency) and the KPI.

delete.summary: Deletes a creative that no ad uses. Approved creatives in use stay for the record.

post.summary:
Approval workflow (same states as social posts): submit, approve (to ClientApproval when the client requires it),
request-changes, and record-client-approval (a note of the client's written approval, audited).

delete.summary: Deletes a planned or concluded experiment; a running test must be concluded first.

post.summary: Copies a plan into a new draft, optionally for another month (flights shift by the same number of months).

get.summary: Client accounts for pickers (id, name, currency, billing email).

put.summary: Sensitive: numbering, terms, reminders and payment instructions (billing.settings, reason, confirm).
Updating a rate never changes existing documents (lines keep their tax snapshot).

delete.summary:
Deletes a tax rate that no document, catalog item, template or setting uses. A rate in use is deactivated instead
(issued documents keep their snapshot either way).

post.summary: Runs the recurring-invoice job now (same idempotent logic as the schedule).

parameters.name: AccountManager
parameters.description: A user id or "me".

get.summary: Health board (red/amber/green with reasons). `?mine=true`: only clients I manage.

post.summary: Onboarding / Active / Paused / Churned (Paused and Churned need a reason). Audited.
Invites a client user by email (new users receive a set-password link).

Marks a client-owned step done (`done: true`) or not done on the client's behalf; audited and shown to the
client as completed by the agency. Agency-owned steps: 400 `onboarding.not_client_item`.

put.summary: Edits an item's title, description, category, owner or position.

delete.summary: Removes a brand asset; its file is deleted once nothing else uses it. A second removal is a 404.

post.summary: Converts a brief into tasks and deliverables on a project.

put.summary: Renames a thread (staff).

post.summary: Turns a meeting action item into a task.

delete.summary: Deletes a draft contract that never billed (otherwise cancel it).

post.summary: Generates any invoices that are due for this contract now (idempotent per period).

parameters.name: View
parameters.description: "review": waiting for my internal review; "client": waiting on clients; "mine": I own it.

delete.summary: Deletes a deliverable the client has never seen (anything sent to the client is part of the approval record).

post.summary: New version: multipart with a file (PNG/JPEG/WebP/PDF/MP4, max 50 MB) and/or a link and/or text, plus notes.
Internal approval: sends the version to the client for review.
Uploads a private file for a client (attachments, brand assets). PNG/JPEG/WebP/PDF/MP4, max 50 MB.

get.summary: Printable HTML invoice (download).

post.summary: Copies an invoice (any status) into a new draft for the same client.
Sensitive: void an issued invoice without payments (billing.manage, reason, confirm, not the issuer).
Sensitive: write off the remaining balance (billing.manage, reason, confirm, not the issuer).
Records a manual payment. Idempotent by `requestId`; 409 on overpayment or a stale invoice stamp.

parameters.name: Member
parameters.description: "me": projects I own or am a member of.

post.summary: Creates a project; with `templateKey` the template's milestones, tasks and recurring tasks are created too.

get.summary: Files of the project (deliverable versions and task attachments).
Budget burn (hours and amount at the user → role → project default hourly rate).
Time logged on the project (time.view_all).

put.summary: Edits the draft, or creates a new version when the current one was already sent.

delete.summary: Deletes a proposal that was never sent (anything sent is withdrawn instead).

post.summary: Live totals for the builder (nothing is saved).
Copies the latest version into a new draft proposal.

get.summary: Registered KPI section providers (OptimizeAll.Api.Modules.Projects.IClientReportSection).

post.summary: Publishes to the client portal and notifies the client's users.

get.summary: Tasks assigned to me. `filter`: open (default), overdue, today, week, done.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: "open" (default), "overdue", "today", "week", "done".

post.summary: Kanban move (status column + position). Also used by the keyboard move controls.
Comment with @mentions (mentioned staff are notified in-app and by email).

put.summary: Edits your own comment (mentions are not re-notified).

delete.summary: Deletes your own comment (project managers may delete any comment).

post.summary: Attaches a file uploaded with POST /agency/clients/{clientId}/files.

delete.summary: Removes an attachment; its file is deleted once nothing else uses it. A second removal is a 404.
Deletes a custom project template (built-in templates are deactivated instead).

post.summary: Starts a timer (409 time.timer_running when one is already running).

get.summary: My entries (default: this week). With time.view_all: `userId`, `projectId` or `clientId`.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: Other users' entries need time.view_all.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: Other users' entries need time.view_all.

get.summary: The week containing `date` (default today) for me, or `userId` (managers).

post.summary:
Reopens a week for editing: the owner can recall a submitted week; a project manager (never for their own week) can
reopen an approved or rejected one (a reason is required for approved weeks).

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: UTC start (default: 30 days before OptimizeAll.Api.Modules.Analytics.AnalyticsQuery.To).

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: UTC end (default: now). Range at most 366 days.

get.summary: Same sections for one campaign plus a per-platform breakdown.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: UTC start (default: 30 days before OptimizeAll.Api.Modules.Analytics.AnalyticsQuery.To).

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: UTC end (default: now). Range at most 366 days.

get.summary: CSV of every overview metric and the per-campaign table (long format).

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: UTC start (default: 30 days before OptimizeAll.Api.Modules.Analytics.AnalyticsQuery.To).

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: UTC end (default: now). Range at most 366 days.

post.summary: Creates a participant account and sends a verification email. Always 202 (no account enumeration).
Returns a short-lived access token and sets the rotating refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie.
Rotates the refresh cookie. Requires the X-Requested-With header (CSRF defence in depth with SameSite=Strict).

Ends the impersonation session ("Exit") and returns the staff member's own session, refreshed from their
untouched refresh cookie. Idempotent: without a live impersonation it just refreshes. 401 when the staff
member's own session is gone too.

get.summary: The signed-in user with roles and effective permissions.
Entries scheduled in [from, to] (default: the next 30 days from today 00:00 UTC; max range 366 days).
Newest first, at most 500; search matches title or slug.

post.summary: "Price for person X on platform Y": the explanation plus the full quote with the person's real caps and budget.

get.summary: Active campaign categories (anonymous).
Browse Active (and upcoming Scheduled) public campaigns with eligibility for the caller.
Campaigns the caller is eligible for, ranked by interests, platforms, reward and deadline.
Campaign detail by slug. InviteOnly campaigns are unlisted but reachable here; Draft/Archived are 404.

post.summary: Online payment through the configured gateway; reports "not available" when none is configured.

get.summary: The organizations the caller belongs to (for the portal's organization picker and KPI requests).
Campaigns waiting for the client's approval.
What the email looks like (sample data), for approval.

post.summary: Uploads a file for a message or brief (any member of the organization).
"I've paid": reports a transfer for staff to confirm. Idempotent by `requestId` (201 new, 200 replay).

get.summary: Organizations I belong to, with my duty in each (org switcher).

post.summary: Owners invite colleagues.

put.summary: Owners tick off onboarding steps the client owns (e.g. "GA4 access granted").

post.summary: Owners upload brand assets (logos, guidelines, photography).

get.summary: `view`: awaiting (my review), approved, or all.

post.summary: Approve the reviewed version (Approver/Owner duty). 409 deliverable.stale_version when a newer version exists.
Submit a brief (Approver/Owner duty).

get.summary: Agency-editable option lists (lost reasons, budget ranges, industries).
Team members who can own deals and be assigned CRM tasks.

parameters.name: Archived
parameters.description: false/omitted: active records only; true: archived records only.

post.summary: Hides the company from lists and pickers (history kept; restorable). A client company can't be archived.
archive, restore, assignOwner, addTag or removeTag on up to 200 companies.

parameters.name: Archived
parameters.description: false/omitted: active records only; true: archived records only.

parameters.name: Archived
parameters.description: false/omitted: active records only; true: archived records only.

post.summary: CSV import (multipart field "file"); validates, dedupes by email and reports a result per row.
archive, restore, assignOwner, setLifecycle, addTag or removeTag on up to 200 contacts.

parameters.name: Archived
parameters.description: false/omitted: active records only; true: archived records only.

parameters.name: Archived
parameters.description: false/omitted: active records only; true: archived records only.

post.summary: Archives a deal (not while a proposal on it waits for the client).
archive, restore or assignOwner on up to 200 deals.
Kanban move (drag or keyboard). Lost requires `lostReason`.

parameters.name: Assignee
parameters.description: "me" or a user id.

parameters.name: Due
parameters.description: open, overdue, today, completed.

get.summary: The caller's open tasks (overdue first).

post.summary: Recomputes every contact's score (after changing rules).

put.summary: Rename, share/unshare or replace the filters of one of your views.

get.summary: Email/SMS KPIs of a client for a period (for client reports).

delete.summary: Erases the contact and their history (GDPR erasure).

post.summary: Manual bounce/complaint import (e.g. from an ESP without webhooks).
Live count of unsaved rules.
Server-side render of unsaved content (editor preview) with sample merge data.

put.summary: Choose the email service provider (sensitive).

post.summary: Sensitive: confirm the send (typed campaign name). The send job does the sending.

get.summary: Templates including archived ones (the regular list endpoint hides them).

delete.summary: Removes the override so the shipped default applies again.

get.summary: Open pixel. Always answers the pixel (an invalid token is simply not recorded) so validity is not revealed.
Click redirect to the stored link (302). Forged tokens or foreign links answer 404, never a redirect.
Opening the unsubscribe link shows the confirmation page (link scanners must not unsubscribe people).

post.summary: RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe (`List-Unsubscribe-Post: List-Unsubscribe=One-Click`). No cookies, no redirects.
SendGrid signed event webhook (ECDSA; requires the verification key in the "sendgrid" integration settings).
Mailgun webhook (HMAC signature with the webhook signing key in the "mailgun" integration).
Twilio inbound SMS (STOP/START keywords). Answers empty TwiML.
Twilio message status callback.

put.summary: Replaces name, hypothesis, element and variants. Only allowed while the experiment is a Draft.

get.summary:
Variant overlays for the caller on every Running experiment of the campaign (sticky assignment). The frontend
overlays these on the campaign detail and sends the variantId with the submission.

Measured results per variant and a two-proportion z-test of each variant's submission rate against control "A".
A difference is only called significant when p < 0.05 and every compared variant has ≥ 100 assignments.

Streams a file. Public campaign/content images are anonymous; submission screenshots only for the owner and
reviewers/campaign managers. Anything the caller may not read is a 404 (existence is not revealed).

post.summary: Uploads a public campaign/content image (PNG, JPEG or WebP, max 10 MB, 200–10000 px per side).

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on CreatedAt (UTC).

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on CreatedAt (UTC).

get.summary: CSV of the ledger with the same filters (max 100,000 rows, newest first).

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on CreatedAt (UTC).

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on CreatedAt (UTC).

post.summary: Manual credit/debit. Idempotent by `requestId`: 201 when created, 200 when replayed.

delete.summary: Archives the form (it stops accepting submissions; submissions are kept).

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Follow-up status filter; by default everything except spam is listed.

delete.summary: Permanently deletes a submission and its uploaded files (e.g. spam or an erasure request).

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Follow-up status filter; by default everything except spam is listed.

get.summary: Embed code: an iframe of /f/{id} plus a postMessage listener that resizes it (only from the app's origin).
External sign-in providers available on this deployment (unconfigured ones are reported disabled).

post.summary: Starts a Google sign-in: returns the Google authorization URL and sets the flow cookie.

Finishes a Google sign-in: exchanges the code, validates the ID token and signs in (sets the refresh cookie),
reports `needsTerms` for a new user, or `linked` for the profile linking flow.
Creates the account of a new Google user once the terms are accepted, and signs them in.

get.summary: The caller's sign-in methods (password yes/no, connected providers).

post.summary: Starts connecting Google to the signed-in account (profile).

delete.summary: Disconnects Google (refused when it is the account's only sign-in method).

get.summary: Dynamic participant homepage: state, onboarding, banners, announcements and counters.

post.summary: Dismisses a Manual onboarding step (idempotent). Other steps complete automatically.
Calls the provider's verifier (where implemented) and records the outcome.
Disconnects: secrets are wiped and adapters stop using the connection; the record stays for history.

delete.summary: Deletes an unused link; a link that has been visited or used is deactivated instead (keeps its stats).

post.summary: Copies a page's draft (all variants) into a new draft page with a free slug. Published versions are not copied.
Brings an archived form back as a draft (activate it in the builder to accept submissions again).

delete.summary: Deletes an agency template; built-in templates are hidden instead.

post.summary: Saves variant A of a page (its draft blocks) as a reusable template; its form block becomes a placeholder.
Uploads a public image for pages (hero, logos, OG image). Returns the /api/v1/files/{id} URL.

delete.summary: Archives the page (taken offline; versions and submissions are kept).

post.summary: Publishes the current draft as a new immutable version (versions are never modified).
Copies a version's content back into the draft (the version itself is unchanged).
Starts a fresh experiment (new assignments and results); takes effect on the next publish.
Submits proof of a post (multipart/form-data with an optional screenshot image).

PostedAt.description: When the post went live (ISO-8601, UTC).

put.summary: Corrects a submission in NeedsCorrection and sends it back to review (multipart/form-data).

post.summary: Appeals a rejection or reversal (once per decision, within the appeal window).

Withdraws a submission that hasn't been decided yet (Pending, UnderReview or NeedsCorrection → Withdrawn). Final;
409 `submission.not_withdrawable` once a reviewer has approved or rejected it.

get.summary: Currencies the platform accepts (OptimizeAll.Domain.Common.Money.SupportedCurrencies), alphabetical.
Platform-wide social-profile eligibility minimums (admin settings) that campaigns start from.
Balance buckets in the settlement currency plus the next payout estimate.
The participant's ledger entries, newest first.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on CreatedAt (UTC).

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on CreatedAt (UTC).

put.summary:
Edits a profile. Changing the handle, profile link, creation date or follower count of a Verified or PendingReview
profile resets it to Unverified (the response says so in `verificationReset` and `message`).

delete.summary: Deactivates (never deletes: past submissions reference the profile).

get.summary: The ticket with its public conversation. Internal staff notes are never included.

post.summary: Reopens a resolved or closed ticket (within 30 days of it being closed).

parameters.name: Method
parameters.description: Incoming payment method (payout records have no method and are excluded when this is set).

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: Participant (payout beneficiary).

parameters.name: OverdueOnly
parameters.description: Only open invoices past their due date (incoming receivables).

get.summary: CSV of every record matching the filters (formula-safe; at most 20,000 rows).

parameters.name: Method
parameters.description: Incoming payment method (payout records have no method and are excluded when this is set).

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: Participant (payout beneficiary).

parameters.name: OverdueOnly
parameters.description: Only open invoices past their due date (incoming receivables).

post.summary: Records a manual incoming payment. Idempotent by `requestId` (201 new, 200 replay).
Records the remaining balance as one payment (idempotent by `requestId`).

patch.summary: Edits reference, date, method or notes of a payment (never the amount). Needs a reason; audited.

post.summary: Sensitive: reverses (Error) or refunds (Refund) a payment; the invoice balance is restored.
Attaches a proof file (PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP; max 10 MB) to a payment.
Confirms a client's report: records the payment (idempotent by claim id) and closes the claim.

put.summary: Sensitive: per-client reminder schedule (billing.settings, reason, audited).

get.summary: Who is calling and what they may do (drives the page's sections and buttons).

post.summary: Prepares (or returns the existing) draft batch for a completed period. 201 when created, 200 when it already existed.
Freezes a draft batch for payment (four-eyes). Items are then dispatched to the payment provider.
Re-dispatches items awaiting payment; existing payment attempts are reused (idempotent).

get.summary:
Sensitive: CSV of the items awaiting payment with the DECRYPTED payout destination, for paying manually.
Requires `?confirm=true`; every export is audited and the first one sets `InstructionsExportedAt`
(after which the batch can no longer be cancelled).
Items whose participant has an active payout hold or an inactive account are NOT payable: they appear after the
payable rows as companion rows whose Status is `EXCLUDED`, whose destination is withheld and replaced by the
reason ("EXCLUDED — do not pay: …").

put.summary: Inserts a new schedule version effective from `effectiveFrom`.

get.summary: Every candidate rate for one post (platform/format, optional campaign and time), which one won and why.

post.summary: Creates a negotiated custom rate (a private card + assignment) for this person, globally or for one campaign.

get.summary: Published FAQ grouped by category. Anonymous.
Active announcements whose audience matches the signed-in user.

post.summary: The unsubscribe confirmation page's button.
Hosted signup form submit. Answers 202 whether or not the address was known (no enumeration).

Revenue attribution (server-to-server), HMAC-SHA256 signed like the tracking postback: header
`X-OA-Signature: sha256=<hex of HMAC(Tracking:PostbackSecret, raw body)>`. Idempotent per external reference.
Custom events for journeys (e.g. cart_abandoned), signed like M:OptimizeAll.Api.Modules.EmailMarketing.Tracking.PublicEmailController.Conversion(System.Threading.CancellationToken).

get.summary: A signed form token (proves minimum fill time) plus the budget/timeline options. Fetch when a form opens.
Free consultation slots (UTC instants) between from and days later.

post.summary: Multipart application with a PDF CV (max 5 MB; verified by content, not by name or MIME type).

Nickname.description: Honeypot: a visually hidden field humans leave empty. Anything here marks the submission as spam.

FormToken.description: Token from `GET /public/forms/token`; proves the form was open long enough to be filled by a person.

Consent.description: Must be true: the visitor ticked the consent checkbox.

ConsentVersion.description: Version of the consent text the visitor saw (from `GET /public/site` → consent).

get.summary:
Invitation landing payload. 404 when the link is inactive, expired or used up. Counts the visit, except for a
staff preview (preview = true from a caller holding marketing.manage), which also makes no
experiment assignment. `preview` from anyone else is ignored.
Public landing page of an Active or Scheduled public campaign.
The published version of a landing page, with the visitor's (sticky) A/B variant and its forms. Counts a view.
Form definition for the embeddable /f/{formId} page. X-Embed-Origin (the embedding site) must be allowed.

post.summary:
Submits a form. JSON body (OptimizeAll.Api.Modules.LandingPages.SubmissionPayload), or multipart/form-data with a "payload" JSON part and one
file part per file field (part name = field key).

get.summary:
302 to the campaign destination with the link's UTM parameters. The destination always comes from stored
configuration (never from the request), so the endpoint cannot be used as an open redirect.

post.summary:
Server-to-server conversion postback signed with HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body
(header X-OA-Signature: sha256=<hex>). Idempotent per (link, externalReference).

get.summary: Site settings for the header, footer, consent banner and head manager (+ the services mega-menu).
A published service with its active packages (ids are stable references for CRM/billing), FAQs and JSON-LD.
Published case studies, optionally filtered by service slug and/or industry slug.
Search across published services, blog posts and case studies (min. 2 characters).
XML sitemap of every published, indexable page.

post.summary: 409 rates.duplicate_assignment (overlapping window, same target/scope), rates.fx_missing, rate_card.not_active.

put.summary: Changes the window (extend or shorten a deal). A start that has passed can't move.

post.summary: Creates a card with version 1 (draft unless "activate": true). 409 rate_card.name_taken.

get.summary: A card with every version (rates, caps, status), its assignments and how many submissions it priced.

put.summary: Renames / re-describes a card (rates change only through new versions). 409 concurrency.conflict.

post.summary:
Saves a new immutable version (confirm + reason; optional future effectiveFrom). A raise above the four-eyes
threshold is saved as PendingApproval. 409 rate_card.version_conflict / rate_card.pending_approval / rates.fx_missing.
Approves a pending rate increase (four-eyes: not its author, not the rate's owner → 403 rates.self_approval).
Archives a card. In use → 409 rate_card.in_use unless "endAssignments": true. Priced submissions keep their rate.
Archives ("deletes") a group. With members/assignments → 409 rate_group.in_use unless "force": true.

get.summary: Members (manual groups) or people matching the rule (automatic groups), with search and paging.

post.summary: Adds up to 10,000 people; returns what was added, unchanged, rejected and flagged.
CSV import (multipart field "file"; a column of emails or user ids). dryRun=true only validates.

get.summary: Membership history (added/removed, by whom, why), newest first.
The caller's referral code, link, program terms, stats and referred participants (masked).

parameters.name: Flagged
parameters.description: true = only referrals with fraud signals; false = only without.

post.summary: Rejects a referral; declines a pending reward or reverses an approved (unpaid) one. Audited.

get.summary: Messages sent per kind in [from, to] (default last 30 days).
Sent retention messages, newest first. Search matches the participant's name or email.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Pending or UnderReview; default both.

parameters.name: Flagged
parameters.description: true = only submissions with unresolved flags; false = only unflagged.

parameters.name: ClaimedByMe
parameters.description: true = only submissions I currently hold an active claim on.

get.summary: Everything needed to review one submission side by side with the campaign requirements.

parameters.name: Due
parameters.description: true (default) = only checks whose due time has passed.

get.summary: All rule set versions (newest first) with their rules and how many submissions reference each.

post.summary: Saves a new version (sensitive: rewards.edit + confirm + reason). Existing submissions keep their version.
Prices a hypothetical post with a saved version or unsaved draft rules.

get.summary:
Searches clients, contacts, deals, projects, invoices, campaigns and users — only the types the caller may open,
tenancy-scoped, at most `limit` (default 5, max 10) per type. 400 `search.query_too_short` under 2
characters; 403 `search.forbidden` without any staff search permission; rate limited (60/min per user).

parameters.name: Q
parameters.description: Search text: at least 2 characters after trimming.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Results per type (1–10, default 5).

delete.summary: Deletes a finished audit and its results (queued or running audits must be cancelled or finish first).

post.summary: Triage one issue of an audit: mark it fixed, ignore it (carried over to later audits) or reopen it.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: ok (2xx), redirect, client-error (4xx), server-error (5xx), failed.

get.summary: New and fixed (rule, URL) pairs compared with against (default: the previous completed audit).

post.summary: CSV import of positions (idempotent per keyword/date/domain). Multipart: file (+ optional date for files without a date column).
Runs the rank-tracking provider now for this site (keywords without today's position).
Pulls the last days days from the Search Console API (NotConfigured unless connected).
CSV: source_url, target_url, anchor(_text), rel, first_seen. Idempotent per (source, target).

put.summary: Edits a backlink's URLs, anchor text or rel. Changing a URL resets the check status.

post.summary: Checks this site's due backlinks now (up to 25; the daily job checks the rest).
Copies a brief (as a new draft) so a similar article can be planned without retyping the outline.

post.summary:
Starts the OAuth flow: returns the network's authorization URL with a signed, expiring state. Answers 409
`social.app_credentials_required` when the developer app id/secret are not configured.

Completes the OAuth flow. The web app's callback page posts the provider's `code` and `state` here; the
state must be untampered, unexpired and issued to the same signed-in user.
Stores a token obtained outside the OAuth flow (e.g. a Meta system-user Page token). Sensitive: integrations.manage.

put.summary:
Per-client settings; turning client approval on or off is audited. Turning it on sends approved and scheduled posts
that the client has not approved back to the client for approval.

the canonical site URL used by links, the sitemap and robots.txt (platform-wide configuration, like admin settings).
